## What you'd like

A clear description of the feature or change.

## Motivation

What problem does it solve? If it relates to a Stable32 / allantools
capability that SigmaTau lacks, name it.

## Reference (for new statistics)

New deviations, EDF/χ² models, or noise-ID methods need a published source
(NIST SP1065, IEEE Std 1139-2022, a journal paper, …). Cite it here if you
have one — it's required before the math can land.

## Additional context

Sketch of the API you'd expect, links, or anything else.
